lmstudio-model-switch v0.1.0

- Initial release.
- Fast switching between LM Studio (local) and Kimi API models for OpenClaw.
- Provides simple commands to change provider or model on-the-fly.
- Automatically backs up and updates openclaw.json configuration.
- Integrates with systemd to restart gateway as needed.
- Useful for balancing privacy, quality, and GPU usage.
